# Load dataset

```{r,warning=FALSE}
df=readRDS("C:\\Users\\P095206\\OneDrive - Amsterdam UMC\\Shared material with Elia\\PhD\\Project 5 - Simulation study in SATs\\Data\\population_hui_like_without_dur_logistic.xlsx") %>% 
  filter(timen<=2) %>% 
  select(id,timen,trt_overall,trt,aoo,sex,hui_linear_trt,yoo) %>% 
  group_by(id,trt) %>% 
  filter(!(trt==1 & !(row_number() %in% c(1,2,3,5,7,9)))) %>% 
  ungroup()
```

## Create dftrial

```{r}
set.seed(03111963)
# sample with function
trialdf=trial_sampler(full_data=df,treatment=trt_overall,id=id,ntrt=20,nctrl=50)%>%
  group_by(id) %>% 
  mutate(id=cur_group_id()) %>% ungroup()
# number of people selected in each dataset
length(unique(df$id));length(unique(trialdf$id))
# sample trialdf
boot_trialdf=bootstrap_sampler(trialdf,id=id,treatment=trt,ntrt=20,nctrl=50)
```

Create baseline df

```{r}
baseline=trialdf %>% 
  group_by(id) %>% 
  filter(row_number()==1) %>% 
  ungroup()
```

Plot all seventy patients

```{r}
# plot cluster without baseline
trialdf %>% 
  #filter(cluster == 3) %>% 
  filter(timen<=2) %>% 
  ggplot(.,aes(x=timen,y=hui_linear_trt,col=factor(trt),group = id))+
  geom_point()+
  geom_line()+
  guides(col='none')+
  xlim(0,2)+
  facet_wrap(~trt)+
  theme_bw()
```

Raw model

```{r}
# model
trial=trialdf %>% 
  group_by(id) %>% 
  mutate(hui_baseline=first(hui_linear_trt)) %>% 
  filter(row_number()!=1) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  lmer(hui_linear_trt~(1|id)+hui_baseline+trt*timen+yoo,.)
# marginalize
estimand=emmeans(trial, ~ trt | timen,
                              at = list(timen=2),
                 cov.reduce=list(yoo=mean))
# see contrast
ate=summary(contrast(estimand, method="trt.vs.ctrl", ref=1))$estimate[1]
```

# Methods

## Exact matching

### Single procedure

```{r}
matched=matching(data=baseline,treatment=trt_overall,ageofonset=aoo,sex=sex,
                 duration=NULL,time=timen,method='greedy',
                 #caliper=NULL,step=NULL,maxcaliper=NULL,
                 caliper=0.5,step=0.1,maxcaliper=0.5,ratio=2,
                 replacement=F,history=F,warning=T)
# inspect
matcheddf=matched$dataset
# get data out and keep only cluster and id
matches = matched$dataset %>%
  mutate(id = baseline$id[id],
         cluster = baseline$id[cluster]) %>%
  select(id, cluster)
# now merge
trialdf_matched=inner_join(trialdf, matches, by = "id") 
# delete baseline measurement
trialdf_analysis=trialdf_matched %>%
  arrange(id, timen) %>% 
  group_by(id) %>% 
  mutate(hui_baseline=first(hui_linear_trt)) %>% 
  filter(row_number()!=1) %>% 
  ungroup()
```

Difference in baseline

```{r}
# mean difference in hui_baseline
trialdf_analysis %>% 
  group_by(id) %>% 
  filter(row_number()==1) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  group_by(trt) %>% 
  summarise(mean=mean(hui_baseline),
            sd=sd(hui_baseline))
# test
t.test(
  hui_baseline ~ trt,
  data = trialdf_analysis %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  filter(row_number() == 1) %>%
  ungroup(),
  var.equal = TRUE)
```

Run model and marginalize

```{r}
# model
trial=trialdf_analysis %>% 
  lmer(hui_linear_trt~(1|cluster)+(1|cluster:id)+hui_baseline+trt*timen+yoo,.)
# marginalize
estimand=emmeans(trial, ~ trt | timen,
                              at = list(timen=2),
                 cov.reduce=list(yoo=mean))
# see contrast
ate=summary(contrast(estimand, method="trt.vs.ctrl", ref=1))$estimate[1]
```

```{r}
# select random cluster
clusters=sample(unique(trialdf_matched$cluster),5)
# table
table(trialdf_matched$trt_overall)
# plot cluster without baseline
trialdf_analysis %>% 
  #filter(cluster == 3) %>% 
  #filter(timen<=2) %>% 
  ggplot(.,aes(x=timen,y=hui_linear_trt,col=factor(trt),group = id))+
  geom_point()+
  geom_line()+
  guides(col='none')+
  xlim(0,2)+
  facet_wrap(~cluster)+
  theme_bw()
# plot cluster with baseline
trialdf_matched %>% 
  #filter(cluster == 3) %>% 
  #filter(timen<=2) %>% 
  ggplot(.,aes(x=timen,y=hui_linear_trt,col=factor(trt),group = id))+
  geom_point()+
  geom_line()+
  guides(col='none')+
  xlim(0,2)+
  facet_wrap(~cluster)+
  theme_bw()
```

## IPTW

### Single procedure

Calculate weights

```{r}
weights=iptw(data=baseline,estimand="ATT",
             formula=trt_overall~aoo+sex)
# extract weights
dataw=weights$data %>% 
  select(id,w)
# merge dataset
trialdfw=merge(trialdf,dataw,by='id')
```

Model

```{r}
options(scipen=999)
fit=trialdfw %>% 
  group_by(id) %>% 
  mutate(hui_baseline=first(hui_linear_trt)) %>% 
  filter(row_number()!=1) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  filter(timen<=2) %>% 
  lmer(hui_linear_trt~(1|id)+hui_baseline+trt_overall*timen+yoo,weights = w,data=.)
```

Predict

```{r}
estimand=emmeans(fit, ~ trt_overall | timen,
                              at = list(timen=2),
                 cov.reduce=list(yoo=mean))
# see contrast
ate=summary(contrast(estimand, method="trt.vs.ctrl", ref=1))$estimate[1]
```

## gcomp

### Single procedure

```{r}
ate=gcomp(trialdf %>% 
            group_by(id) %>% 
            mutate(hui_baseline=first(hui_linear_trt)) %>% 
            filter(row_number()!=1) %>% 
            ungroup() %>% 
            filter(timen<=2),
          estimate="ate",
          estimand="ATT",
          treatment="trt_overall",
          time="timen",
          formula=hui_linear_trt~(1|id)+hui_baseline+trt_overall*timen+aoo+sex+yoo,
          landmark=2)[1]
```
